title.en: Hong Kong PHLSB outpatient antimicrobial resistance
title.zh: 香港 PHLSB 门诊细菌耐药统计

unit_of_observation: Year × specimen type × organism × drug or resistance marker

source.provider: Department of Health, Hong Kong SAR Government; Public Health Laboratory Services Branch

terms.attribution: Source: Department of Health, Hong Kong SAR Government, via DATA.GOV.HK. Source data remain the intellectual property of the Government and relevant organisations.
terms.scope: Data are redistributed and restructured with attribution under the DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use; project MIT license applies to the parser and interface, not the source data.

definitions.R: Resistant. The 2025 detailed PHLSB table reports R and I separately; these merged CSV drug values match the R rows.
definitions.I: Intermediate. I is not present as separate rows in this merged CSV and is not added to R.
definitions.positive: Marker-positive count. BL, ESBL, KPC, NDM and OXA-48-like are distinguished from drug resistance.
definitions.reported_total: The source No. row for that organism, specimen and year. Retained as reported; it is not re-labelled as an independently verified drug-specific AST denominator.
definitions.reported_percent: Official reported percentage, retained with its source precision. Percentages are never reconstructed for count-only cells.
definitions.not_reported: A source dash or blank remains null; a missing result is not changed to zero.
definitions.question_mark: The source CSV contains literal question marks in place of separators in names and numeric cells. The raw strings are retained; normalized labels use spaces and the numeric parser accepts only the observed count?(percent%) pattern.
definitions.source_rows: 1-based logical CSV row numbers; source_data_row holds the observation and source_total_row holds its No. row.

normalization_rules: Forward-fill organism only inside its specimen block.
Attach each block’s No. row by year; retain it separately as reported_total.
Preserve raw labels and cells, footnote symbols, cell coordinates and source digest.
Remove * and ^ from normalized organism labels while retaining their source footnotes.
Keep plus-labelled resistance markers separate from drug_resistance.
Do not create rows for intrinsic-resistance footnotes; no drug result cell exists for them.
Carry [MRSA] as an annotation to Oxacillin.
No clinical–wastewater pairing or predictive analysis is included.
